card.name: The word time in "at a time"
card.fires_on: The word "time" or "times" ending the phrases "at a time", "at all times" and "at any one time", mostly in rules about how many items to use or what must always hold.

modes.description: "time" ends "at a time" after a limit such as only one patch or one person.

modes.label: At all times
modes.description: "times" ends "at all times" in a rule that must always hold.
